title: Use Group IV – uses subject to size limitations
previewText: For uses denoted with an “S” in Section 42-141 (Use Group IV – general use allowances), the provisions of this Section shall apply. Gas utility substations in all Manufacturing Districts shall be limited to a site of not more than 10,000 square feet.
